_why: Pages that draw their own list or editor for a family of configured things (planning#440 step 6, D1013). A family is a contiguous block that its U packet deletes with the page. The list only shrinks.

integrationInstances.packages/addon-admin-ui/src/components/i: the Add-integration wizard (discovery, mode and broker steps) creates the record itself; it is a create flow with steps InstanceCreateDialog does not have, and it lists no instances
integrationInstances.packages/addon-admin-ui/src/components/s: a lead block drawn INSIDE InstanceEditorDialog (its `lead` slot): it patches one field of the record the dialog is editing; the list and the editor are the shared ones
integrationInstances.packages/addon-admin-ui/src/pages/Integr: the integration page's Delete button calls deleteInstance on the record the page shows; its list is the integration's devices, not instances, and its editor is IntegrationInstanceEditor over InstanceEditorDialog
integrationInstances.packages/addon-admin-ui/src/pages/system: a lead block drawn inside InstanceEditorDialog: it patches one field of the profile record being edited
a lead block drawn inside InstanceEditorDialog: it patches the settings of the terminal profile record being edited
